title: Bank Statement Processing and Transaction Cleaning Workflow
summary: n8n workflow that detects which bank a statement came from, identifies its header structure, and parses transactions into one clean, standard format.
problem: Bank statements arrive in different formats, so transactions cannot be combined or analysed without manual cleaning.
objective: Turn any supported bank statement into one clean, standard transaction format automatically.
approach: Custom Detect Bank & Header and universal Parse Statement Code nodes in n8n.
process: Detected the bank and header structure of each statement
Parsed transactions with a universal Parse Statement node
